turnLimitScope: One ACP prompt; cancel/stop on any tool-call or client permission request. Top-level --max-turns is not forwarded to the agent branch in the inspected official source.
prompt:
Metadata-only design review; no tools/web/files. RealBud desktop will accept typed website work requests, never shell/text commands. Local explicit opt-in binds installation, workspace UUID, immutable member profile and catalog revision. A separate random command credential is persisted before enrollment; reporting credentials never poll/claim. Portal billing owners may request/cancel but cannot approve. Local preview and decision bind exact current plan, pack instructions, reviewed source/settings, grant generation and expiry. Only morning-review or supported prepare-recipe adapters reuse existing loop/job receipt dedup by a saved stable request key. A short online claim with stable claim ID serializes cancellation/revocation/expiry before dispatch. Recheck local bindings, current billing and source authorization after awaited calls. Claims are not permission to restart stale work offline. Persist received envelope, decision, dispatch intent and status outbox; reconcile ambiguous crash outcomes against actual run receipts without new keys. Outcomes stay local; portal sees enumerated phase/timestamps/run reference only, no messages/results/errors/secrets. Backup restores history and request/run links but invalidates grants and approvals. Enrollment, poll, claim and status updates recheck active installation/company/account; desktop grants never retarget across profiles. First mode requires local review; remote approval needs future distinct enrollment.
Return top 3 concrete failure interleavings and tests, ranked by severity. Focus on duplicate execution after crash/lost replies, authority changes across claim/dispatch, and cross-agency/privacy/restore boundaries. State which durable evidence proves the result. JSON only {"cases":[{"title":"...","setup":"...","assertions":["..."]}]} exactly 3 cases, at most 4 assertions each, under 280 words. Advice only, not implementation or test evidence.
authentication: Existing cached auth via opaque symlink in disposable private GROK_HOME; harness never opens auth contents.

cases.title: Restore retargets a profile
cases.setup: Enroll I1, W1, P1; persist the command credential before enrollment. Approve plan, pack, source, grant G, expiry E. Backup envelope, decision, receipt, and outcome. Restore onto I2, company B, P2; claim, dispatch, and post results.
assertions: Restored grants and approvals are invalid and must not retarget or dispatch as P2.
History and request/run links restore, but first mode needs a new local review, not remote approval.
Poll, claim, and status recheck installation, company, and account; reporting credentials never claim.
Proof: invalidated G, binding mismatch, no new receipt, outbox only phase, timestamps, and run reference.

cases.title: Authority drops before dispatch
cases.setup: Decision binds plan, pack, source, G, and E. Claim C is in flight when owner cancel, expiry, source revocation, or billing change lands; the awaited call then returns. Retry expired C offline.
assertions: If cancel, revocation, or expiry wins, C has no dispatch intent or run receipt.
Post-await recheck of bindings, billing, and source auth blocks a stale generation.
Expired C cannot restart work offline, and a billing owner cannot approve.
Proof: ordered claim log, decision bound to G, E, plan, and source, and no receipt.

cases.title: Lost reply double-dispatches
cases.setup: Morning-review or prepare-recipe saves stable key K, envelope, decision, and dispatch intent. Claim C is accepted; crash or lost reply before outbox commit. Restart mints a new key or reruns offline; another adapter reuses dedup.
assertions: Reconcile K against the actual receipt and mint no new request key or claim.
A receipt for K blocks another dispatch; if absent, resume only C after recheck.
Unsupported adapters must not reuse loop or job receipt dedup.
Proof: one K receipt, sole claim C, matching outbox phase, and no second intent.
